text: Hey Noy - congratulations on your husband getting the B1 visa! You can find a list of the documents on our website. As you will see, there are some "additional documents" that are only required by some branches-  but the rent contract and bills are normal. You should not need to bring any of the additional documents unless you were asked to. https://aic.org.il/list-of-documents-required-for-the-partner-visa-application-renewal/
